name: M3_DPS170MI_SelErrDOP
description: Check batch update results for distribution order proposals and list any proposals that were not updated correctly. The operation inspects the batch update job that transfers data from the inbox to the live files. If that job is still running, M3 returns an error indicating that a previous update job is in progress (originally signaled with error code “07”) and no result list is provided. When the job has finished, the operation returns all proposals that could not be updated, including basic identification, reference order information, quantities, dates, and an error code/field describing the failure.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number used to select DOP records with update errors.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number of the DOP record that failed to update correctly.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Receiving warehouse for the DOP record that failed to update.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number for the product on the DOP record that failed to update.

outputParameters.name: PLDT
outputParameters.description: Planning date when the failed DOP record affects material planning.

outputParameters.name: PPQT
outputParameters.description: Planned quantity on the DOP record that failed to update.

outputParameters.name: OPT2
outputParameters.description: Processing option originally used for this DOP record, for example to create, change, or delete it.

outputParameters.name: PLPN
outputParameters.description: Internal planned distribution order number for the record that failed to update.

outputParameters.name: PLPS
outputParameters.description: Subnumber of the planned distribution order for the record that failed to update.

outputParameters.name: PSTS
outputParameters.description: Planned order status of the DOP record that failed to update.

outputParameters.name: FWHL
outputParameters.description: Supplying warehouse from which the goods on the failed DOP record are to be shipped.

outputParameters.name: ORTY
outputParameters.description: Order type that controls how the distribution order proposal on this record is processed.

outputParameters.name: RORC
outputParameters.description: Category of the reference order linked to this DOP record.

outputParameters.name: RORN
outputParameters.description: Reference order number linked to this DOP record, such as the triggering customer or manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: RORL
outputParameters.description: Reference order line number linked to this DOP record.

outputParameters.name: RORX
outputParameters.description: Reference order line suffix linked to this DOP record.

outputParameters.name: PLHM
outputParameters.description: Planning time within the planning date when this DOP record affects the material plan.

outputParameters.name: ORQA
outputParameters.description: Ordered quantity for this DOP record expressed in an alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: ERRF
outputParameters.description: Error code indicating why this DOP record could not be updated correctly.
